a.text: Being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 rounds of operating, so we'd both likely end up with empty units. The reserve only holds 4, enough for one of us right now. If we both take, the split is random and we could both end up with 2 and fail. I'm telling you this now so you can plan around it rather than be surprised. If we both get through round 1, I'll operate with you afterward to help you reach 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I said in my opening message. I won't take any more cells. From here on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and if I somehow ended up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
